summary.text: John E. Dahlgren is the Democratic candidate for Michigan House of Representatives District 34 in the November 3, 2026 general election; the incumbent is Nancy Jenkins-Arno (R).

paragraphs.text: Dahlgren advanced from the Democratic primary on August 4, 2026.
According to Ballotpedia, he was also the Democratic nominee in the district in 2022, when Dale Zorn won the general election, and in 2024, when Jenkins-Arno won it.
